dex.entry: A flat, disc-shaped solar ray-fish that drifts through the Solarium's flooded halls like a living sunbeam, its body fully translucent except for a golden radial pattern of stored-light cells. A solar ray floating in dark water like a living stained-glass window — beautiful and alien.

art.silhouette: Flat circular body, translucent amber with a golden starburst vein-pattern at the centre; six thin trailing rays fanning back like a sun's corona; floats serenely; elegant at 40px.
